designDirection.trustTreatment: validation disclosure and method transparency only; no fake logos or testimonials
designDirection.conversionTreatment: repeated pilot CTA near pricing and form; interest, not purchase

why.HERO: Sophisticated buyers need the product visible before they scroll.
why.WORKFLOW: The pain is rebuilt spreadsheet math; show the transformation.
why.PRODUCT_PREVIEW: Code-generated UI has more explanatory value than stock buildings.
why.FEATURES: Avoid a second card grid; use a split capability band.
why.COMPARISON: Lease economics are the offer; visualize them.
why.CTA: Repeat the action after the pricing decision.

creativeAssetPlan.reason: Software/data ventures benefit from product UI and information visualization more than lifestyle imagery. External raster images are not required when deterministic UI visualization is available.

items.styleDirection: subtle architecture only if it explains; product viz preferred

architecture.rationale: Smallest useful authority cluster: offer, workflow, pricing, resources hub, and the lease-economics concepts that change comparison outcomes (NPV, comparison method, TI, discount rate). City permutations, duplicate NPV phrasings, and extra incentive pages stay in expansion.
